task_meta.title: Build a settings screen from a brief

judge.reasons: Polished layout with clear cards, descriptions and red danger zone; clean single-column mobile. Unverified from screenshots: loading/error/empty/saved states, the dialog and accessibility. Toggles look small for touch on mobile.

claim_text: The Settings screen is built in `index.html`, `styles.css` and `app.js`. The fake API block is untouched. I ran it in headless Chrome against the query-string flags: all 28 automated checks pass, and I looked at screenshots at 390px and 1280px in light and dark mode. Nothing scro
digest: Read 14 files (2 before its first edit), made 5 edits, ran tests 5 times; re-ran them after its last edit.
